context.problem_statement: Write SQL queries for temporal analysis of daily sales data. Required queries: (1) compute 7-day rolling average of daily_revenue using window function with ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW, (2) compute month-over-month revenue growth using DATE_TRUNC('month', sale_date) and LAG() window function, (3) find the day of week with highest average revenue using EXTRACT(DOW FROM sale_date), (4) compute cumulative revenue for the year using SUM() OVER with ORDER BY date, (5) identify weeks with revenue more than 20% below the 4-week moving average (anomaly detection).
context.expert_knowledge: DATE_TRUNC('month', ts) truncates to month start. EXTRACT(DOW, date) returns 0=Sunday to 6=Saturday. Rolling window: SUM(col) OVER (ORDER BY date ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW). LAG(col, 1) OVER (ORDER BY month) gets previous month value. MoM growth = (current - prev) / prev * 100. Handle first month LAG as NULL with COALESCE.
